subject: a compact Enramados smithy seen as a side elevation: one open forge bay with the glowing forge mouth and the anvil, a thick tiled eave, an offset fieldstone chimney joined to the roof, timber posts and a stone plinth on the ground

brief.story: the gameplay forge: the same family as the hero workshop of the pack, compressed to one bay; the smith works at the anvil in the bay
brief.light: a warm forge glow inside the bay

footprint_note: a simulacao da a forja 120 px de largura (data/source/buildings.csv, forge.width_px); a tela de 128 e a grelha de 32 da Asset Bible (Q-295)

references.note: a oficina do pacote: os sinais (chamine, boca da forja, bigorna, apoios, beiral) a manter; a planta comprime-se para uma baia (escala: compressao ~0,27)
